defects.note: TO_DATE with one argument whose own call contains commas (nested SUBSTR)
TO_TIMESTAMP with one argument inside a CASE expression; a string literal mentions a two-argument form
number local compared with a string literal in EXIT WHEN inside a loop
DATE parameter compared with a numeric literal inside a CASE expression
VARCHAR2 local compared (<>) with a numeric literal in an ELSIF after a local function

negatives.note: TO_DATE with two arguments where the mask is a function call; the one-argument form is only in a string and a comment
comparison-looking text only inside a string literal and a comment; real comparisons are same-family
anchored %TYPE local is unknown; a function-call operand is not a simple operand
same-family comparisons only: BOOLEAN with TRUE, number with number, text with text, date with date
cursor-loop record fields are not parameters or simple locals, so they are not resolved
